I inspected all three allowlisted files (README.md, subject.mjs via the masked archive results, and contract.json fully recovered). The contract requirements are:

1. History is an array of at most twelve complete exchanges — enforced (`length > 0 && length <= 12`), plus `history_ref` format.
2. Call IDs nonempty, unique per exchange — enforced.
3. Every result role is `tool`, ID matches positional call — enforced.
4. Masking affects old content only — enforced via `step >= history.length - recentCount` retention gate; original journal bytes stay external (only hashes and recovery pointers are embedded).

The supplied subject.mjs source satisfies each requirement, so I propose the complete replacement restoring exactly the inspected source bytes, preserving all unrelated behavior.
